primary_distance_source: Numeric trajectory.npy members of twelve archived NPZ datasets; fully specified by distance_parameters.json and rebuild_distances.py. All speed/acceleration observations verified bitwise against the feature caches.
legacy_note: Original directed matrices and symmetric repairs retained only as sensitivity inputs. Legacy feature sampling, RNG state and scaling cannot be recovered. This does not affect the newly reconstructed primary distances.
training_note: Training and its configuration are maintained separately. This repository covers evaluation outcomes and post-training analysis. Dataset row counts describe the archived feature-analysis inputs. Run directory indices label training replicates and do not assert paired random seeds.
